subject_description: the same back-facing Ash Warden knight in dark charcoal plate armor, ragged ash-grey tabard, horned crown and one large straight ember greatsword
initial_pose: standing facing NORTH away from the viewer, both boots planted at the bottom of the tabard, sword lowered on his right
description: One powerful TWO-HANDED OVERHEAD SLAM, always facing NORTH with his BACK towards the camera. Both hands grasp the same sword hilt, elbows rise, slowly lift the entire greatsword straight ABOVE the helmet with the blade pointing upward; pause for a clearly readable high overhead apex. Then drive the sword vertically DOWN and FORWARD into the ground NORTH of his feet, away from the camera, bending the torso and knees into a heavy follow-through. A narrow short amber motion streak follows the blade only during contact. Recover back to the EXACT initial back-facing stance. Keep the feet planted at their original pixel positions, the camera fixed and the character size constant. Keep the same angular armor, ash-grey torn cloth and sword shape and muted colors. Clearly visible raised arms and overhead blade. No horizontal or sideways sweep, no spinning, no turn toward viewer, no second weapon, no explosion, no new fire wave, no camera movement. Leave transparent breathing room above the sword.
